capacityRules: transport.capacity must be >= party.adults + party.children + party.elderly
group users should prefer 16-seat airport van or grouped transfers
islandTransferRules: If windLevel=strong or seaCondition=choppy, add 30-45 minutes transfer buffer
If cableCarStatus=delayed and elderlyMode=true, suggest waiting lounge or mainland dining instead of rushing
If late arrival after 19:30, avoid scheduling VinWonders entry on day 1
If hotel.zone=Đảo Hòn Tre, always include return transfer before flight
pacingRules: family with elderly: avoid more than 2 medium/high walkLevel activities in same day
childTired=true: insert rest block within next 60 minutes
elderlyMode=true: prefer buggy, shuttle, indoor, low walkLevel
weatherRules: rainProb >= 60: deprioritize weatherSensitive=true unless attraction is signature and near
heavy_rain: replace water park/outdoor gardens with Sea World/Mermaid Show/Spa
very_hot: avoid outdoor activity between 12:00 and 15:30
windy/strong wind: monitor cable car, zipline and speedboat
queueRules: queueMin >= 40: suggest fastpass or alternate attraction
queueMin >= 55: avoid unless user interest is thrill and pace=active
cable car queue >= 45: show transfer delay banner and propose lounge/meal buffer
voucherRules: expires within 24h: surface voucher in plan if applicable and user tier is eligible
F&B voucher: match restaurant.acceptsVoucher and minSpend
late checkout: recommend for afternoon/evening return flights
priority cable car voucher: recommend for Gold+ users on crowded days
